slides.headline: A wedding day. The bride and groom step out of the *church*.
The bride clings to his arm and looks *up* at him.
But an armoured soldier blocks the *way*.
His steel hand points the groom toward the *war*.
The groom stops. His face shows he already *knows*.
Behind the knight, more soldiers wait with their *spears*.
Her wedding flowers are still fresh in her *hand*.
At the church door, the guests suddenly fall *silent*.
Neighbours lean out of their windows to *watch*.
Rose petals still lie on the steps from the *ceremony*.
Married for an hour. Will he ever *come* back?
